entries.statement: {E : Type u_1} → [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] → [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] → Set E → E → ℝ

entries.name: supportFn_add
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {K K' : Set E} {R R' : ℝ}, K.Nonempty → (∀ x ∈ K, ‖x‖ ≤ R) → K'.Nonempty → (∀ x ∈ K', ‖x‖ ≤ R') → ∀ (ξ : E), supportFn (K + K') ξ = supportFn K ξ + supportFn K' ξ

entries.name: supportFn_add_le
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {K : Set E} {R : ℝ}, K.Nonempty → (∀ x ∈ K, ‖x‖ ≤ R) → ∀ (ξ ξ' : E), supportFn K (ξ + ξ') ≤ supportFn K ξ + supportFn K ξ'

entries.name: supportFn_eq_sSup
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (K : Set E) (ξ : E), supportFn K ξ = sSup ((fun x => inner ℝ x ξ) '' K)

entries.name: supportFn_image
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {F : Type u_2} [inst_2 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_3 : InnerProductSpace ℝ F] (K : Set E) {L : E → F} {L' : F → E}, (∀ (x : E) (ξ : F), inner ℝ (L x) ξ = inner ℝ x (L' ξ)) → ∀ (ξ : F), supportFn (L '' K) ξ = supportFn K (L' ξ)

entries.name: supportFn_le
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {K : Set E} {ξ : E}, K.Nonempty → ∀ {c : ℝ}, (∀ x ∈ K, inner ℝ x ξ ≤ c) → supportFn K ξ ≤ c

entries.name: supportFn_le_mul_norm
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {K : Set E} {R : ℝ}, K.Nonempty → (∀ x ∈ K, ‖x‖ ≤ R) → ∀ (ξ : E), supportFn K ξ ≤ R * ‖ξ‖

entries.name: supportFn_mono
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {K K' : Set E} {R : ℝ}, K.Nonempty → (∀ x ∈ K', ‖x‖ ≤ R) → K ⊆ K' → ∀ (ξ : E), supportFn K ξ ≤ supportFn K' ξ

entries.name: supportFn_neg_set
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (K : Set E) (ξ : E), supportFn (-K) ξ = supportFn K (-ξ)

entries.name: supportFn_of_subsingleton
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [Subsingleton E] (K : Set E) (ξ : E), supportFn K ξ = 0

entries.name: supportFn_smul
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (K : Set E) {c : ℝ}, 0 ≤ c → ∀ (ξ : E), supportFn K (c • ξ) = c * supportFn K ξ

entries.name: supportFn_smul_set
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (K : Set E) {c : ℝ}, 0 ≤ c → ∀ (ξ : E), supportFn (c • K) ξ = c * supportFn K ξ

entries.name: supportFn_sub_le
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {K : Set E} {R : ℝ}, K.Nonempty → (∀ x ∈ K, ‖x‖ ≤ R) → ∀ (ξ ξ' : E), supportFn K ξ - supportFn K ξ' ≤ R * ‖ξ - ξ'‖

entries.name: tendsto_partialSupInner
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {K : Set E} {R : ℝ} {q : ℕ → E}, (∀ (n : ℕ), q n ∈ K) → (∀ x ∈ K, ‖x‖ ≤ R) → (∀ (v : E), supportFn K v = ⨆ n, inner ℝ (q n) v) → ∀ (v : E), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => partialSupInner q n v) Filter.atTop (nhds (supportFn K v))

entries.name: COLT83.adjoint_euclideanClm

entries.name: COLT83.barrierScore
entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → [Fintype ι] → [DecidableEq ι] → ℝ → Matrix ι ι ℝ → (ι → ℝ) → ℝ

entries.name: COLT83.barrier_average
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {B : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {l : ℝ} [Nonempty ι], B.IsHermitian → (∀ x ∈ spectrum ℝ B, l < x) → COLT83.barrier l B ≤ 1 → ∀ {𝒴 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ}, COLT83.IsDesign 𝒴 w → COLT83.designMatrix w = 1 → (∀ x ∈ spectrum ℝ B, l + 1 / 2 < x) ∧ ∃ x ∈ w.support, 1 ≤ COLT83.barrierScore l B x.ofLp

entries.name: COLT83.barrier_eq_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {B : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {l : ℝ} (hB : B.IsHermitian), (∀ x ∈ spectrum ℝ B, l < x) → COLT83.barrier l B = ∑ i, (hB.eigenvalues i - l)⁻¹

entries.name: COLT83.barrier_lt_barrier_add_half
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {B : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {l : ℝ} [Nonempty ι], B.IsHermitian → (∀ x ∈ spectrum ℝ B, l + 1 / 2 < x) → COLT83.barrier l B < COLT83.barrier (l + 1 / 2) B

entries.name: COLT83.barrier_neg_card_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι], COLT83.barrier (-↑(Fintype.card ι)) 0 = 1

entries.name: COLT83.barrier_step
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {B : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {l : ℝ} {u : ι → ℝ} [Nonempty ι], B.IsHermitian → (∀ x ∈ spectrum ℝ B, l + 1 / 2 < x) → 1 ≤ COLT83.barrierScore l B u → (∀ x ∈ spectrum ℝ (B + Matrix.vecMulVec u u), l + 1 / 2 < x) ∧ COLT83.barrier (l + 1 / 2) (B + Matrix.vecMulVec u u) ≤ COLT83.barrier l B

entries.name: COLT83.baseline_le_budget_of_isPAC
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)), IsCompact 𝒳 → Submodule.span ℝ 𝒳 = ⊤ → 2 ≤ Fintype.card ι → ∀ {ε δ : ℝ}, 0 < ε → δ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (1 / 4) → ∀ {T : ℕ} (A : Learning.IdentAlg ↑𝒳 ℝ ↑𝒳), A.IsFixedBudget T → Learning.LinearBandit.IsPAC 𝒳 A ε δ → (2 - √2) / (32 * ε ^ 2) * Real.log (1 / (4 * δ)) ≤ ↑T

entries.name: COLT83.bayesC
entries.statement: ℝ → ℝ

entries.name: COLT83.bayesHist
entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → [Fintype ι] → [DecidableEq ι] → {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} → {T : ℕ} → (x : Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) → (∀ (t : Fin T), x t ∈ 𝒳) → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin T) → Fin T → ↑𝒳 × ℝ

entries.name: COLT83.bayesHist_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {T : ℕ} (x : Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (hx : ∀ (t : Fin T), x t ∈ 𝒳) (τ : ℝ) (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin T)), COLT83.bayesHist x hx τ p = fun t => (⟨x t, ⋯⟩, COLT83.bayesObs x τ p t)

entries.name: COLT83.bayesHist_eq_comp
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {T : ℕ} (x : Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (hx : ∀ (t : Fin T), x t ∈ 𝒳) (τ : ℝ) (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin T)), COLT83.bayesHist x hx τ p = (fun y t => (⟨x t, ⋯⟩, y.ofLp t)) ((COLT83.bayesYclm x τ) p)

entries.name: COLT83.bayesJoint
entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → [Fintype ι] → [DecidableEq ι] → {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} → {T : ℕ} → Learning.IdentAlg ↑𝒳 ℝ ↑𝒳 → (x : Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) → (∀ (t : Fin T), x t ∈ 𝒳) → ℝ → MeasureTheory.Measure ((EuclideanSpace ℝ ι × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin T)) × ↑𝒳)

entries.name: COLT83.bayesKernel
entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → [Fintype ι] → [DecidableEq ι] → {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} → {T : ℕ} → Learning.IdentAlg ↑𝒳 ℝ ↑𝒳 → (x : Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) → (∀ (t : Fin T), x t ∈ 𝒳) → ℝ → ProbabilityTheory.Kernel (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin T)) ↑𝒳

entries.name: COLT83.bayesKernel_comap
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {T : ℕ} (A : Learning.IdentAlg ↑𝒳 ℝ ↑𝒳) (x : Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (hx : ∀ (t : Fin T), x t ∈ 𝒳) (τ : ℝ) (g : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (COLT83.bayesKernel A x hx τ).comap (Prod.mk g) ⋯ = (A.output T).comap (fun η => COLT83.bayesHist x hx τ (g, η)) ⋯

entries.name: COLT83.bayesLSclm
entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → [Fintype ι] → [DecidableEq ι] → {T : ℕ} → (Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin T) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι

entries.name: COLT83.bayesLSclm_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {T : ℕ} (x : Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (τ : ℝ), (∑ t, COLT83.outerSelf (x t)).PosDef → ∀ (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin T)), (COLT83.bayesLSclm x τ) p = COLT83.leastSquares x (COLT83.bayesObs x τ p)

entries.name: COLT83.bayesObs
entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → [Fintype ι] → [DecidableEq ι] → {T : ℕ} → (Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin T) → Fin T → ℝ

entries.name: COLT83.bayesObs_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {T : ℕ} (x : Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (τ : ℝ) (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin T)), COLT83.bayesObs x τ p = fun t => inner ℝ (x t) (COLT83.bayesParam x τ p.1) + p.2.ofLp t

entries.name: COLT83.bayesParam
entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → [Fintype ι] → [DecidableEq ι] → {T : ℕ} → (Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι

entries.name: COLT83.bayesParamClm
entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → [Fintype ι] → [DecidableEq ι] → {T : ℕ} → (Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin T) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι

entries.name: COLT83.bayesParamClm_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {T : ℕ} (x : Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (τ : ℝ) (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin T)), (COLT83.bayesParamClm x τ) p = COLT83.bayesParam x τ p.1

entries.name: COLT83.bayesParamClm_eq_add
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {T : ℕ} (x : Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (τ : ℝ), (∑ t, COLT83.outerSelf (x t)).PosDef → ∀ (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin T)), (COLT83.bayesParamClm x τ) p = (COLT83.bayesWclm x τ) p + COLT83.bayesC τ • (COLT83.bayesLSclm x τ) p

entries.name: COLT83.bayesParam_sub_smul_leastSquares
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {T : ℕ} (x : Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (τ : ℝ), (∑ t, COLT83.outerSelf (x t)).PosDef → ∀ (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin T)), COLT83.bayesParam x τ p.1 - COLT83.bayesC τ • COLT83.leastSquares x (COLT83.bayesObs x τ p) = (COLT83.bayesW₁ x τ) p.1 + (COLT83.bayesW₂ x τ) p.2

entries.name: COLT83.bayesWclm
entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → [Fintype ι] → [DecidableEq ι] → {T : ℕ} → (Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin T) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι

entries.name: COLT83.bayesWclm_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {T : ℕ} (x : Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (τ : ℝ) (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin T)), (COLT83.bayesWclm x τ) p = (COLT83.bayesW₁ x τ) p.1 + (COLT83.bayesW₂ x τ) p.2

entries.name: COLT83.bayesW₁
entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → [Fintype ι] → [DecidableEq ι] → {T : ℕ} → (Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι

entries.name: COLT83.bayesW₁_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {T : ℕ} (x : Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (τ : ℝ) (g : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (COLT83.bayesW₁ x τ) g = (1 - COLT83.bayesC τ) • COLT83.bayesParam x τ g

entries.name: COLT83.bayesW₁_comp_adjoint_bayesY₁_add
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {T : ℕ} (x : Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (τ : ℝ), (∑ t, COLT83.outerSelf (x t)).PosDef → COLT83.bayesW₁ x τ ∘SL ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (COLT83.bayesY₁ x τ) + COLT83.bayesW₂ x τ ∘SL ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin T))) = 0

entries.name: COLT83.bayesW₂
entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → [Fintype ι] → [DecidableEq ι] → {T : ℕ} → (Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin T) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι

entries.name: COLT83.bayesW₂_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {T : ℕ} (x : Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (τ : ℝ) (η : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin T)), (COLT83.bayesW₂ x τ) η = -(COLT83.bayesC τ • (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (COLT83.lsMatrix x)) η)

entries.name: COLT83.bayesYclm
entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → [Fintype ι] → [DecidableEq ι] → {T : ℕ} → (Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin T) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin T)

entries.name: COLT83.bayesYclm_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {T : ℕ} (x : Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (τ : ℝ) (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin T)), (COLT83.bayesYclm x τ) p = (COLT83.bayesY₁ x τ) p.1 + p.2

entries.name: COLT83.bayesY₁
entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → [Fintype ι] → [DecidableEq ι] → {T : ℕ} → (Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin T)

entries.name: COLT83.bayesY₁_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {T : ℕ} (x : Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (τ : ℝ) (g : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (COLT83.bayesY₁ x τ) g = WithLp.toLp 2 fun t => inner ℝ (x t) (COLT83.bayesParam x τ g)

entries.statement: (k d : ℕ) → Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k × Fin d))

entries.name: COLT83.blockBallSet_le_budget_of_isFixedDesign_of_isPAC
entries.statement: ∀ (k d : ℕ) {ε δ : ℝ}, ε ∈ Set.Ioc 0 1 → δ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 (1 / 10) → ∀ {T : ℕ} (A : Learning.IdentAlg ↑(COLT83.blockBallSet k d) ℝ ↑(COLT83.blockBallSet k d)), A.IsFixedBudget T → A.IsFixedDesign → Learning.LinearBandit.IsPAC (COLT83.blockBallSet k d) A ε δ → ↑k * ↑d ^ 2 / (210 * ε ^ 2) ≤ ↑T

entries.name: COLT83.blockBallSet_le_budget_of_isPAC
entries.statement: ∀ (k d : ℕ), 2 ≤ k * d → ∀ {ε δ : ℝ}, 0 < ε → δ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (1 / 16) → ∀ {T : ℕ} (A : Learning.IdentAlg ↑(COLT83.blockBallSet k d) ℝ ↑(COLT83.blockBallSet k d)), A.IsFixedBudget T → Learning.LinearBandit.IsPAC (COLT83.blockBallSet k d) A ε δ → ↑k * ↑d * Real.log (1 / δ) / (20000 * ε ^ 2) ≤ ↑T

entries.name: COLT83.blockCenter
entries.statement: {m : ℕ} → {d : Fin m → ℕ} → Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))

entries.name: COLT83.blockCenter_add
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (l : Fin m) (v w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))), COLT83.blockCenter l (v + w) = COLT83.blockCenter l v + COLT83.blockCenter l w

entries.name: COLT83.blockCenter_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (l : Fin m) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))) (i : (j : Fin m) × Fin (d j)), (COLT83.blockCenter l v).ofLp i = if i.fst = l then v.ofLp i - COLT83.blockSum v l / ↑(d l) else 0

entries.name: COLT83.blockCenter_apply_mk_of_ne
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (l : Fin m) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))) {j : Fin m}, j ≠ l → ∀ (k : Fin (d j)), (COLT83.blockCenter l v).ofLp ⟨j, k⟩ = 0

entries.name: COLT83.blockCenter_apply_mk_self
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (l : Fin m) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))) (k : Fin (d l)), (COLT83.blockCenter l v).ofLp ⟨l, k⟩ = v.ofLp ⟨l, k⟩ - COLT83.blockSum v l / ↑(d l)

entries.name: COLT83.blockCenter_blockCenter
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ}, (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < d j) → ∀ (l l' : Fin m) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))), COLT83.blockCenter l (COLT83.blockCenter l' v) = if l = l' then COLT83.blockCenter l v else 0

entries.name: COLT83.blockCenter_mtL
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ}, (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < d j) → ∀ (l : Fin m) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))), COLT83.blockCenter l ((COLT83.mtL d) v) = √↑(d l) • COLT83.blockCenter l v

entries.name: COLT83.blockCenter_muVec
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ}, (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < d j) → ∀ (l : Fin m), COLT83.blockCenter l (COLT83.muVec d) = 0

entries.name: COLT83.blockCenter_smul
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (l : Fin m) (c : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))), COLT83.blockCenter l (c • v) = c • COLT83.blockCenter l v

entries.name: COLT83.blockCenter_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} {α : Type u_1} (l : Fin m) (s : Finset α) (v : α → EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))), COLT83.blockCenter l (∑ a ∈ s, v a) = ∑ a ∈ s, COLT83.blockCenter l (v a)

entries.name: COLT83.blockSumLin_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (j : Fin m) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))), (COLT83.blockSumLin d j) y = COLT83.blockSum y j

entries.name: COLT83.blockSum_add
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (y z : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))) (j : Fin m), COLT83.blockSum (y + z) j = COLT83.blockSum y j + COLT83.blockSum z j

entries.name: COLT83.blockSum_blockCenter
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ}, (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < d j) → ∀ (l : Fin m) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))) (j : Fin m), COLT83.blockSum (COLT83.blockCenter l v) j = 0

entries.name: COLT83.blockSum_mtL
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ}, (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < d j) → ∀ (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))) (j : Fin m), COLT83.blockSum ((COLT83.mtL d) v) j = COLT83.mtA d * inner ℝ (COLT83.muVec d) v

entries.name: COLT83.blockSum_muVec
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ}, (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < d j) → ∀ (j : Fin m), COLT83.blockSum (COLT83.muVec d) j = 1

entries.name: COLT83.blockSum_oneHot
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (κ : (j : Fin m) → Fin (d j)) (j : Fin m), COLT83.blockSum (COLT83.oneHot d κ) j = 1

entries.name: COLT83.blockSum_single
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (j' : Fin m) (l : Fin (d j')) (a : ℝ) (j : Fin m), COLT83.blockSum (EuclideanSpace.single ⟨j', l⟩ a) j = if j = j' then a else 0

entries.name: COLT83.blockSum_smul
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (c : ℝ) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))) (j : Fin m), COLT83.blockSum (c • y) j = c * COLT83.blockSum y j

entries.name: COLT83.blockSum_sub
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (y z : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))) (j : Fin m), COLT83.blockSum (y - z) j = COLT83.blockSum y j - COLT83.blockSum z j

entries.name: COLT83.blockSum_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} {α : Type u_1} (s : Finset α) (y : α → EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))) (j : Fin m), COLT83.blockSum (∑ a ∈ s, y a) j = ∑ a ∈ s, COLT83.blockSum (y a) j

entries.name: COLT83.card_pi_eq_mul
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (l : Fin m), Fintype.card ((j : Fin m) → Fin (d j)) = d l * Fintype.card ((j : { j // j ≠ l }) → Fin (d ↑j))

entries.name: COLT83.ciSup_const_add_const_mul

entries.name: COLT83.continuous_bayesObs

entries.name: COLT83.continuous_diffSup

entries.name: COLT83.designMatrix_mixDesign
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (w₁ w₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ), COLT83.designMatrix (COLT83.mixDesign w₁ w₂) = (1 / 2) • COLT83.designMatrix w₁ + (1 / 2) • COLT83.designMatrix w₂

entries.name: COLT83.designSet_image_toEuclideanCLM
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ), COLT83.designSet (⇑(Matrix.toEuclideanCLM M) '' 𝒳) = (fun A => M * A * M.transpose) '' COLT83.designSet 𝒳

entries.name: COLT83.designWeight
entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → NNReal

entries.name: COLT83.det_smul_add_smul_outerSelf
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ}, IsUnit A.det → ∀ {t : ℝ}, t ≠ 1 → ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), ((1 - t) • A + t • COLT83.outerSelf x).det = (1 - t) ^ Fintype.card ι * A.det * (1 + t / (1 - t) * x.ofLp ⬝ᵥ A⁻¹.mulVec x.ofLp)

entries.name: COLT83.diffSup_eq_supportFn_add_neg
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {𝒳 : Set E} {R : ℝ}, 𝒳.Nonempty → (∀ x ∈ 𝒳, ‖x‖ ≤ R) → ∀ (v : E), COLT83.diffSup 𝒳 v = supportFn (𝒳 + -𝒳) v

entries.name: COLT83.diffSup_pos_of_inner_eq_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {T : ℕ}, IsCompact 𝒳 → Submodule.span ℝ 𝒳 = ⊤ → ∀ {x : Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι}, (∀ (t : Fin T), x t ∈ 𝒳) → 1 ≤ T → ∀ {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι}, v ≠ 0 → (∀ (t : Fin T), inner ℝ (x t) v = 0) → 0 < COLT83.diffSup 𝒳 v

entries.name: COLT83.dotProduct_inv_mulVec_le_gValue
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι], IsCompact 𝒳 → x ∈ 𝒳 → x.ofLp ⬝ᵥ A⁻¹.mulVec x.ofLp ≤ COLT83.gValue 𝒳 A

entries.name: COLT83.dotProduct_inv_mulVec_le_of_smul_le
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {A C : Matrix ι ι ℝ}, A.PosDef → ∀ {T : ℕ}, 0 < T → (↑T / 4) • A ≤ C → ∀ (x : ι → ℝ), x ⬝ᵥ C⁻¹.mulVec x ≤ 4 / ↑T * x ⬝ᵥ A⁻¹.mulVec x

entries.name: COLT83.dotProduct_mulVec_eq_trace_mul_outerSelf
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), x.ofLp ⬝ᵥ M.mulVec x.ofLp = (M * COLT83.outerSelf x).trace

entries.name: COLT83.dotProduct_outerSelf_mulVec
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (u y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), u.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (COLT83.outerSelf y).mulVec u.ofLp = inner ℝ u y ^ 2

entries.name: COLT83.eigenvalues_gt
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {B : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {l : ℝ} (hB : B.IsHermitian), (∀ x ∈ spectrum ℝ B, l < x) → ∀ (i : ι), l < hB.eigenvalues i

entries.name: COLT83.euclideanClm

entries.name: COLT83.euclideanClm_comp
entries.statement: ∀ {m : Type u_2} {n : Type u_3} {k : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype m] [inst_1 : Fintype n] [inst_2 : Fintype k] [inst_3 : DecidableEq n] [inst_4 : DecidableEq k] (M : Matrix m n ℝ) (N : Matrix n k ℝ), COLT83.euclideanClm M ∘SL COLT83.euclideanClm N = COLT83.euclideanClm (M * N)

entries.name: COLT83.exists_isAccurateNormEst
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {ε δ : ℝ}, ε ∈ Set.Ioc 0 1 → δ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1 → ∃ T, ↑T ≤ 100000 * ↑(Fintype.card ι) * Real.log (4 / δ) / ε ^ 2 ∧ ∃ A, A.IsFixedBudget T ∧ COLT83.IsAccurateNormEst A ε δ

entries.name: COLT83.exists_isDesign_of_mem_designSet
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} [inst : Fintype ι], A ∈ COLT83.designSet 𝒳 → ∃ w, COLT83.IsDesign 𝒳 w ∧ COLT83.designMatrix w = A ∧ w.support.card ≤ Fintype.card ι ^ 2 + 1

entries.name: COLT83.exists_isFixedDesign_isPAC
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)), IsCompact 𝒳 → 𝒳.Nonempty → Submodule.span ℝ 𝒳 = ⊤ → ∀ {ε δ : ℝ}, ε ∈ Set.Ioc 0 1 → δ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1 → ∃ T, ↑T ≤ 600 * (COLT83.gw 𝒳 ^ 2 + ↑(Fintype.card ι) * Real.log (2 / δ)) / ε ^ 2 + 1 ∧ ∃ A, A.IsFixedBudget T ∧ A.IsFixedDesign ∧ Learning.LinearBandit.IsPAC 𝒳 A ε δ

entries.name: COLT83.exists_isGOptimalDesign
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι], IsCompact 𝒳 → Submodule.span ℝ 𝒳 = ⊤ → ∃ w, COLT83.IsGOptimalDesign 𝒳 w

entries.name: COLT83.exists_isMaxOn_det_designSet
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι], IsCompact 𝒳 → 𝒳.Nonempty → ∃ A ∈ COLT83.designSet 𝒳, IsMaxOn Matrix.det (COLT83.designSet 𝒳) A

entries.name: COLT83.exists_isPAC_blockBallSet
entries.statement: ∀ (k d : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → ∀ {ε δ : ℝ}, ε ∈ Set.Ioc 0 1 → δ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1 → ∃ T, ↑T ≤ 2000000 * (↑k * ↑d * Real.log (8 * ↑k / δ) + ↑d ^ 2) / ε ^ 2 ∧ ∃ A, A.IsFixedBudget T ∧ Learning.LinearBandit.IsPAC (COLT83.blockBallSet k d) A ε δ

entries.name: COLT83.exists_isPAC_of_finite
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)), 𝒳.Finite → 𝒳.Nonempty → Submodule.span ℝ 𝒳 = ⊤ → ∀ {ε δ : ℝ}, ε ∈ Set.Ioc 0 1 → δ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1 → ∃ T, ↑T ≤ 97281 * ↑(Fintype.card ι) * (Real.log (max 1 (↑𝒳.ncard / ↑(Fintype.card ι))) + Real.log (4 / δ)) / ε ^ 2 ∧ ∃ A, A.IsFixedBudget T ∧ Learning.LinearBandit.IsPAC 𝒳 A ε δ

entries.name: COLT83.exists_ne_zero_inner_eq_zero_of_not_posDef
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {T : ℕ} {x : Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι}, ¬(∑ t, COLT83.outerSelf (x t)).PosDef → ∃ v, v ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ (t : Fin T), inner ℝ (x t) v = 0

entries.name: COLT83.exists_posDef_mem_designSet
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} [Finite ι] [Nonempty ι], Submodule.span ℝ 𝒳 = ⊤ → ∃ A ∈ COLT83.designSet 𝒳, A.PosDef

entries.name: COLT83.exists_rounding
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ} [Nonempty ι], COLT83.IsDesign 𝒳 w → (COLT83.designMatrix w).PosDef → ∀ {T : ℕ}, 4 * Fintype.card ι ≤ T → ∃ x, (∀ (t : Fin T), x t ∈ w.support) ∧ (↑T / 4) • COLT83.designMatrix w ≤ ∑ t, COLT83.outerSelf (x t)

entries.name: COLT83.exists_singular_instances
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {T : ℕ}, IsCompact 𝒳 → Submodule.span ℝ 𝒳 = ⊤ → ∀ {x : Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι}, (∀ (t : Fin T), x t ∈ 𝒳) → 1 ≤ T → ¬(∑ t, COLT83.outerSelf (x t)).PosDef → ∀ {ε : ℝ}, 0 < ε → ∃ θ θ', (∀ (t : Fin T), inner ℝ (x t) θ = 0) ∧ (∀ (t : Fin T), inner ℝ (x t) θ' = 0) ∧ ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Learning.LinearBandit.simpleRegret 𝒳 θ y + Learning.LinearBandit.simpleRegret 𝒳 θ' y = 4 * ε

entries.name: COLT83.finrank_span_multitaskSet_add
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ}, (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < d j) → 0 < m → Module.finrank ℝ ↥(Submodule.span ℝ (COLT83.multitaskSet d)) + (m - 1) = Fintype.card ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))

entries.name: COLT83.gValue_le

entries.name: COLT83.gwMat_anti
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ}, IsCompact K → K.Nonempty → A.PosDef → A ≤ B → COLT83.gwMat K B ≤ COLT83.gwMat K A

entries.name: COLT83.gwMat_designMatrix_mixDesign_le
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {w₁ w₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ} [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι], IsCompact 𝒳 → 𝒳.Nonempty → (COLT83.designMatrix w₁).PosDef → (COLT83.designMatrix w₂).PosSemidef → COLT83.gwMat 𝒳 (COLT83.designMatrix (COLT83.mixDesign w₁ w₂)) ≤ √2 * COLT83.gwMat 𝒳 (COLT83.designMatrix w₁)

entries.name: COLT83.gwMat_eq_gaussianWidth_stdGaussian
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {R : ℝ}, K.Nonempty → (∀ x ∈ K, ‖x‖ ≤ R) → ∀ (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ), COLT83.gwMat K A = ProbabilityTheory.gaussianWidth (⇑(Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (CFC.sqrt A⁻¹)) '' K) (ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι))

entries.name: COLT83.gwMat_image

entries.name: COLT83.gwMat_le_mul_sqrt_card
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {R : ℝ}, K.Nonempty → (∀ x ∈ K, ‖x‖ ≤ R) → ∀ (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) {R' : ℝ}, (∀ x ∈ K, ‖(Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (CFC.sqrt A⁻¹)) x‖ ≤ R') → COLT83.gwMat K A ≤ R' * √↑(Fintype.card ι)

entries.name: COLT83.gwMat_le_of_smul_le
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {A C : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {R : ℝ}, IsCompact 𝒳 → 𝒳.Nonempty → (∀ x ∈ 𝒳, ‖x‖ ≤ R) → A.PosDef → ∀ {T : ℕ}, 0 < T → (↑T / 4) • A ≤ C → COLT83.gwMat 𝒳 C ≤ 2 / √↑T * COLT83.gwMat 𝒳 A

entries.name: COLT83.gwMat_le_regionalizedGw
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {κ : Type u_2} [Finite κ] (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (𝓡 : κ → Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)) (i : κ), COLT83.gwMat (𝓡 i) A ≤ COLT83.regionalizedGw A 𝓡

entries.name: COLT83.gwMat_mono
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {R : ℝ} {K' : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)}, K.Nonempty → (∀ x ∈ K', ‖x‖ ≤ R) → K ⊆ K' → ∀ (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ), COLT83.gwMat K A ≤ COLT83.gwMat K' A

entries.name: COLT83.gwMat_neg_set
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {R : ℝ} {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ}, K.Nonempty → (∀ x ∈ K, ‖x‖ ≤ R) → A.PosDef → COLT83.gwMat (-K) A = COLT83.gwMat K A

entries.name: COLT83.gwMat_nonneg
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {R : ℝ}, K.Nonempty → (∀ x ∈ K, ‖x‖ ≤ R) → ∀ (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ), 0 ≤ COLT83.gwMat K A

entries.name: COLT83.gwMat_of_isEmpty
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [IsEmpty ι] (K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)) (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ), COLT83.gwMat K A = 0

entries.name: COLT83.gwMat_smul
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {R : ℝ} {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ}, K.Nonempty → (∀ x ∈ K, ‖x‖ ≤ R) → A.PosDef → ∀ {c : ℝ}, 0 < c → COLT83.gwMat K (c • A) = (√c)⁻¹ * COLT83.gwMat K A

entries.name: COLT83.gwMat_sub_set
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {R : ℝ} {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ}, K.Nonempty → (∀ x ∈ K, ‖x‖ ≤ R) → A.PosDef → COLT83.gwMat (K - K) A = 2 * COLT83.gwMat K A

entries.name: COLT83.gw_eq_iInf

entries.name: COLT83.gw_image
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {R : ℝ}, 𝒳.Nonempty → (∀ x ∈ 𝒳, ‖x‖ ≤ R) → (∃ A ∈ COLT83.designSet 𝒳, A.PosDef) → ∀ {M : Matrix ι ι ℝ}, IsUnit M → COLT83.gw (⇑(Matrix.toEuclideanCLM M) '' 𝒳) = COLT83.gw 𝒳

entries.name: COLT83.gw_le_card

entries.name: COLT83.gw_le_gwMat
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {R : ℝ} {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ}, 𝒳.Nonempty → (∀ x ∈ 𝒳, ‖x‖ ≤ R) → A ∈ COLT83.designSet 𝒳 → A.PosDef → COLT83.gw 𝒳 ≤ COLT83.gwMat 𝒳 A

entries.name: COLT83.gw_le_sqrt_log_ncard
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)), 𝒳.Finite → 𝒳.Nonempty → Submodule.span ℝ 𝒳 = ⊤ → COLT83.gw 𝒳 ≤ √(2 * ↑(Fintype.card ι) * Real.log ↑𝒳.ncard)

entries.name: COLT83.gw_le_sqrt_mul_gwMat_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {R : ℝ}, 𝒳.Nonempty → (∀ x ∈ 𝒳, ‖x‖ ≤ R) → ∀ {T : ℕ}, 0 < T → ∀ {x : Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι}, (∀ (t : Fin T), x t ∈ 𝒳) → (∑ t, COLT83.outerSelf (x t)).PosDef → COLT83.gw 𝒳 ≤ √↑T * COLT83.gwMat 𝒳 (∑ t, COLT83.outerSelf (x t))

entries.name: COLT83.gw_nonneg
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {R : ℝ}, 𝒳.Nonempty → (∀ x ∈ 𝒳, ‖x‖ ≤ R) → 0 ≤ COLT83.gw 𝒳

entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι} {Ω : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_2 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {X : ℕ → Ω → ↑𝒳} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {x : ℕ → ↑𝒳}, Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq X Y (Learning.fixedDesignAlg x) (Learning.LinearBandit.linearGaussianEnv 𝒳 θ) P → ∀ (T : ℕ), (∑ t, COLT83.outerSelf ↑(x ↑t)).PosDef → ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw (fun ω => COLT83.leastSquares (fun t => ↑(x ↑t)) fun t => Y (↑t) ω) (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian θ (∑ t, COLT83.outerSelf ↑(x ↑t))⁻¹) P

entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} (alg : Learning.Algorithm ↑𝒳 ℝ) (N : ℕ) (θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) {E : Set (↥(Finset.Iic N) → ↑𝒳 × ℝ)}, MeasurableSet E → (COLT83.histLaw alg N θ) E = (Learning.trajMeasure alg (Learning.LinearBandit.linearGaussianEnv 𝒳 θ)) (Learning.IT.hist N ⁻¹' E)

entries.name: COLT83.inner_blockCenter_left
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (l : Fin m) (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))), inner ℝ (COLT83.blockCenter l x) y = ∑ k, x.ofLp ⟨l, k⟩ * y.ofLp ⟨l, k⟩ - COLT83.blockSum x l * COLT83.blockSum y l / ↑(d l)

entries.name: COLT83.inner_blockCenter_symm
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (l : Fin m) (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))), inner ℝ (COLT83.blockCenter l x) y = inner ℝ x (COLT83.blockCenter l y)

entries.name: COLT83.inner_blockInd
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (j : Fin m) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))), inner ℝ (COLT83.blockInd d j) v = COLT83.blockSum v j

entries.name: COLT83.inner_msParam_sub_insert

entries.name: COLT83.map_bayesParam_stdGaussian
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {T : ℕ} (x : Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (τ : ℝ), (∑ t, COLT83.outerSelf (x t)).PosDef → MeasureTheory.Measure.map (COLT83.bayesParam x τ) (ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)) = ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 (τ ^ 2 • (∑ t, COLT83.outerSelf (x t))⁻¹)

entries.name: COLT83.measureReal_diffSup_gt_le
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)}, IsCompact 𝒳 → 𝒳.Nonempty → ∀ {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ}, A.PosDef → ∀ {σ : NNReal}, 0 < σ → (∀ x ∈ 𝒳, x.ofLp ⬝ᵥ A⁻¹.mulVec x.ofLp ≤ ↑σ ^ 2) → ∀ {δ : ℝ}, δ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1 → (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 A⁻¹).real {v | 2 * COLT83.gwMat 𝒳 A + 2 * ↑σ * √(2 * ↑ProbabilityTheory.gaussianConcentrationConst * Real.log (1 / δ)) < COLT83.diffSup 𝒳 v} ≤ δ

entries.name: COLT83.measureReal_lt_simpleRegret_bayes_le
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace E] [inst_3 : OpensMeasurableSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E] {𝒳 : Set E} {A : Learning.IdentAlg ↑𝒳 ℝ ↑𝒳} {T : ℕ} [ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel (A.output T)] {x' : ℕ → ↑𝒳} {ε δ : ℝ}, Learning.LinearBandit.IsPAC 𝒳 A ε δ → A.IsFixedBudget T → A.alg = Learning.fixedDesignAlg x' → ∀ (θ : E), (Learning.LinearBandit.fixedDesignPairLaw A (fun t => x' ↑t) θ).real {p | ε < Learning.LinearBandit.simpleRegret 𝒳 θ ↑p.2} ≤ δ

entries.name: COLT83.measureReal_lt_simpleRegret_comap_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {T : ℕ} (A : Learning.IdentAlg ↑𝒳 ℝ ↑𝒳) (x : Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (hx : ∀ (t : Fin T), x t ∈ 𝒳) (τ : ℝ) [ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel (A.output T)] (g : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) {ε : ℝ}, ((ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin T))).compProd ((COLT83.bayesKernel A x hx τ).comap (Prod.mk g) ⋯)).real {q | ε < Learning.LinearBandit.simpleRegret 𝒳 (COLT83.bayesParam x τ g) ↑q.2} = (Learning.LinearBandit.fixedDesignPairLaw A (fun t => ⟨x t, ⋯⟩) (COLT83.bayesParam x τ g)).real {p | ε < Learning.LinearBandit.simpleRegret 𝒳 (COLT83.bayesParam x τ g) ↑p.2}

entries.name: COLT83.mtL
entries.statement: {m : ℕ} → (d : Fin m → ℕ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j)) →ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))

entries.name: COLT83.mtL_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))), (COLT83.mtL d) v = (COLT83.mtA d * inner ℝ (COLT83.muVec d) v) • COLT83.muVec d + ∑ l, √↑(d l) • COLT83.blockCenter l v

entries.name: COLT83.mtL_apply_mk
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ}, (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < d j) → ∀ (g : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))) (j : Fin m) (k : Fin (d j)), ((COLT83.mtL d) g).ofLp ⟨j, k⟩ = inner ℝ ((COLT83.mtA d * (↑(d j))⁻¹) • COLT83.muVec d - (√↑(d j) / ↑(d j)) • COLT83.blockInd d j) g + √↑(d j) * inner ℝ (EuclideanSpace.single ⟨j, k⟩ 1) g

entries.name: COLT83.mtL_mem_span
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ}, (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < d j) → ∀ (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))), (COLT83.mtL d) v ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (COLT83.multitaskSet d)

entries.name: COLT83.mtL_mtL
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ}, (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < d j) → ∀ (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))), (COLT83.mtL d) ((COLT83.mtL d) v) = (COLT83.mtA d ^ 2 * COLT83.kappa d * inner ℝ (COLT83.muVec d) v) • COLT83.muVec d + ∑ l, ↑(d l) • COLT83.blockCenter l v

entries.name: COLT83.mtParam0_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} {ε : ℝ} (κ : (j : Fin m) → Fin (d j)) (j : Fin m) (i : (j : Fin m) × Fin (d j)), (COLT83.mtParam0 d ε κ j).ofLp i = if i.fst = j then 0 else if i.snd = κ i.fst then 10 * COLT83.mtEps d ε i.fst else 0

entries.name: COLT83.mtParam_apply

entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {w₁ w₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ}, (COLT83.designMatrix w₁).PosDef → (COLT83.designMatrix w₂).PosSemidef → (COLT83.designMatrix (COLT83.mixDesign w₁ w₂)).PosDef

entries.name: COLT83.posDef_of_isMaxOn_det
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι], Submodule.span ℝ 𝒳 = ⊤ → A ∈ COLT83.designSet 𝒳 → IsMaxOn Matrix.det (COLT83.designSet 𝒳) A → A.PosDef

entries.name: COLT83.posDef_of_smul_le
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {A C : Matrix ι ι ℝ}, A.PosDef → ∀ {T : ℕ}, 0 < T → (↑T / 4) • A ≤ C → C.PosDef

entries.name: COLT83.posSemidef_of_mem_designSet
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} [Finite ι], A ∈ COLT83.designSet 𝒳 → A.PosSemidef

entries.name: COLT83.posSemidef_sum_outerSelf
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [Finite ι] {κ : Type u_2} (s : Finset κ) (x : κ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (∑ t ∈ s, COLT83.outerSelf (x t)).PosSemidef

entries.name: COLT83.regionalizedGw
entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → [Fintype ι] → [DecidableEq ι] → {κ : Type u_2} → Matrix ι ι ℝ → (κ → Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)) → ℝ

entries.name: COLT83.regionalizedGw_le
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {κ : Type u_2} [Nonempty κ] {𝓡 : κ → Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {c : ℝ}, (∀ (i : κ), COLT83.gwMat (𝓡 i) A ≤ c) → COLT83.regionalizedGw A 𝓡 ≤ c

entries.name: COLT83.regionalizedGw_le_gwMat
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {R : ℝ} {κ : Type u_2} [Nonempty κ] {𝓡 : κ → Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)}, (∀ (i : κ), 𝓡 i ⊆ 𝒳) → (∀ (i : κ), (𝓡 i).Nonempty) → (∀ x ∈ 𝒳, ‖x‖ ≤ R) → ∀ (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ), COLT83.regionalizedGw A 𝓡 ≤ COLT83.gwMat 𝒳 A

entries.name: COLT83.regionalizedGw_nonneg
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {R : ℝ} {κ : Type u_2} [Finite κ] [Nonempty κ] {𝓡 : κ → Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)}, (∀ (i : κ), (𝓡 i).Nonempty) → (∀ (i : κ), ∀ x ∈ 𝓡 i, ‖x‖ ≤ R) → ∀ (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ), 0 ≤ COLT83.regionalizedGw A 𝓡

entries.name: COLT83.signVec
entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → (ι → Bool) → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι

entries.name: COLT83.signVecZero
entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → (ι → Bool) → ι → [DecidableEq ι] → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι

entries.name: COLT83.signVecZero_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {s : ι → Bool} {j : ι} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (i : ι), (COLT83.signVecZero s j).ofLp i = if i = j then 0 else if s i = true then 1 else -1

entries.name: COLT83.signVecZero_flipAt
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (j : ι) (s : ι → Bool), COLT83.signVecZero (Function.update s j !s j) j = COLT83.signVecZero s j

entries.name: COLT83.signVecZero_update
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {s : ι → Bool} {j : ι} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (b : Bool), COLT83.signVecZero (Function.update s j b) j = COLT83.signVecZero s j

entries.name: COLT83.signVec_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {s : ι → Bool} (i : ι), (COLT83.signVec s).ofLp i = if s i = true then 1 else -1

entries.name: COLT83.signVec_apply_ne_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {s : ι → Bool} (i : ι), (COLT83.signVec s).ofLp i ≠ 0

entries.name: COLT83.simpleRegret_eq_supportFn_sub
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {𝒳 : Set E} (θ x : E), Learning.LinearBandit.simpleRegret 𝒳 θ x = supportFn 𝒳 θ - inner ℝ x θ

entries.name: COLT83.simpleRegret_le_supportFn_add_supportFn
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {𝒳 : Set E} {R : ℝ}, 𝒳.Nonempty → (∀ x ∈ 𝒳, ‖x‖ ≤ R) → ∀ {θ θ' x : E}, x ∈ 𝒳 → ∀ {γ : ℝ}, supportFn 𝒳 θ' - γ ≤ inner ℝ x θ' → Learning.LinearBandit.simpleRegret 𝒳 θ x ≤ supportFn 𝒳 (θ - θ') + supportFn 𝒳 (θ' - θ) + γ

entries.name: COLT83.simpleRegret_smul_add_simpleRegret_neg_smul
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {α : ℝ}, 0 ≤ α → ∀ (v y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Learning.LinearBandit.simpleRegret 𝒳 (α • v) y + Learning.LinearBandit.simpleRegret 𝒳 (-(α • v)) y = α * COLT83.diffSup 𝒳 v

entries.name: COLT83.simpleRegret_smul_signVec
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {u : Bool → ℝ} {c : ℝ}, u false < u true → 0 < c → ∀ (s : ι → Bool) {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι}, x ∈ COLT83.cubeSet u → Learning.LinearBandit.simpleRegret (COLT83.cubeSet u) (c • COLT83.signVec s) x = c * (u true - u false) * ↑(COLT83.hammingCard u s x)

entries.name: COLT83.single_sub_single_mem_span
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ}, (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < d j) → ∀ (i : (j : Fin m) × Fin (d j)) (l : Fin (d i.fst)), EuclideanSpace.single i 1 - EuclideanSpace.single ⟨i.fst, l⟩ 1 ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (COLT83.multitaskSet d)

entries.name: COLT83.smul_designMatrix_le_designMatrix_mixDesign_left
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {w₁ w₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ}, (COLT83.designMatrix w₂).PosSemidef → (1 / 2) • COLT83.designMatrix w₁ ≤ COLT83.designMatrix (COLT83.mixDesign w₁ w₂)

entries.name: COLT83.smul_designMatrix_le_designMatrix_mixDesign_right
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {w₁ w₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ}, (COLT83.designMatrix w₁).PosSemidef → (1 / 2) • COLT83.designMatrix w₂ ≤ COLT83.designMatrix (COLT83.mixDesign w₁ w₂)

entries.name: COLT83.spanBasisMatrix
entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → [Fintype ι] → (𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)) → Matrix ι (Fin (Module.finrank ℝ ↥(Submodule.span ℝ 𝒳))) ℝ

entries.name: COLT83.spanBasisMatrix_mulVec_transpose_mulVec
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι}, v ∈ Submodule.span ℝ 𝒳 → (COLT83.spanBasisMatrix 𝒳).mulVec ((COLT83.spanBasisMatrix 𝒳).transpose.mulVec v.ofLp) = v.ofLp

entries.name: COLT83.span_image_toEuclideanCLM_eq_top
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {M : Matrix ι ι ℝ}, IsUnit M → Submodule.span ℝ 𝒳 = ⊤ → Submodule.span ℝ (⇑(Matrix.toEuclideanCLM M) '' 𝒳) = ⊤

entries.name: COLT83.sq_signVec_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {s : ι → Bool} (i : ι), (COLT83.signVec s).ofLp i ^ 2 = 1

entries.name: COLT83.sqrtInvDesign
entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → [Fintype ι] → [DecidableEq ι] → {T : ℕ} → (Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι

entries.name: COLT83.sqrt_log_le_gw
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)), IsCompact 𝒳 → 𝒳.Nonempty → Submodule.span ℝ 𝒳 = ⊤ → 4 ≤ Fintype.card ι → √(↑(Fintype.card ι) * Real.log ↑(Fintype.card ι / 2)) / 8 ≤ COLT83.gw 𝒳

entries.name: COLT83.sqrt_log_le_gwMat
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ} {R : ℝ}, COLT83.IsDesign 𝒳 w → (COLT83.designMatrix w).PosDef → 𝒳.Nonempty → (∀ x ∈ 𝒳, ‖x‖ ≤ R) → 4 ≤ Fintype.card ι → √(↑(Fintype.card ι) * Real.log ↑(Fintype.card ι / 2)) / 8 ≤ COLT83.gwMat 𝒳 (COLT83.designMatrix w)

entries.name: COLT83.sum_inner_stdOrthonormalBasis_mul_inner
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι}, x ∈ Submodule.span ℝ 𝒳 → ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), ∑ k, inner ℝ (↑((stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ ↥(Submodule.span ℝ 𝒳)) k)) x * inner ℝ (↑((stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ ↥(Submodule.span ℝ 𝒳)) k)) y = inner ℝ x y

entries.name: COLT83.sum_inner_stdOrthonormalBasis_smul
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι}, x ∈ Submodule.span ℝ 𝒳 → ∑ k, inner ℝ (↑((stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ ↥(Submodule.span ℝ 𝒳)) k)) x • ↑((stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ ↥(Submodule.span ℝ 𝒳)) k) = x

entries.name: COLT83.sum_ite_apply_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (l : Fin m) (k : Fin (d l)), (∑ κ, if k = κ l then 1 else 0) = ↑(Fintype.card ((j : { j // j ≠ l }) → Fin (d ↑j)))

entries.name: COLT83.sum_mtEps
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ}, 0 < m → (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < d j) → ∀ (ε : ℝ), ∑ j, COLT83.mtEps d ε j = ε

entries.name: COLT83.sum_mul_dotProduct_inv_mulVec
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι], IsUnit (COLT83.designMatrix w).det → ∑ x ∈ w.support, w x * x.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (COLT83.designMatrix w)⁻¹.mulVec x.ofLp = ↑(Fintype.card ι)

entries.name: COLT83.sum_mul_dotProduct_mulVec
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (C : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ), ∑ x ∈ w.support, w x * x.ofLp ⬝ᵥ C.mulVec x.ofLp = (C * COLT83.designMatrix w).trace

entries.name: COLT83.sum_mul_inner_sqrt_inv_sq
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ}, (COLT83.designMatrix w).PosDef → ∀ (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), ∑ x ∈ w.support, w x * inner ℝ ((Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (CFC.sqrt (COLT83.designMatrix w)⁻¹)) x) v ^ 2 = ‖v‖ ^ 2

entries.name: COLT83.sum_pi_split
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (l : Fin m) (F : ((j : Fin m) → Fin (d j)) → ℝ), ∑ κ, F κ = ∑ a, ∑ r, F ((Equiv.piSplitAt l fun j => Fin (d j)).symm (a, r))

entries.name: COLT83.sum_sqrt_le_sqrt_card_mul_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (f : α → ℝ), (∀ (a : α), 0 ≤ f a) → ∑ a, √(f a) ≤ √(↑(Fintype.card α) * ∑ a, f a)

entries.name: COLT83.supportFn_cubeSet
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {u : Bool → ℝ} (θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), supportFn (COLT83.cubeSet u) θ = ∑ i, max (u true * θ.ofLp i) (u false * θ.ofLp i)

entries.name: COLT83.supportFn_cubeSet_smul_signVec
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {u : Bool → ℝ} {c : ℝ}, u false < u true → 0 < c → ∀ (s : ι → Bool), supportFn (COLT83.cubeSet u) (c • COLT83.signVec s) = c * ∑ i, u (s i) * (COLT83.signVec s).ofLp i

entries.name: COLT83.supportFn_msParam
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {m : ℕ} {Δ : ℝ} {S : Finset ι}, 0 ≤ Δ → S.card = m → m ≤ Fintype.card ι → supportFn (COLT83.mSet ι m) (COLT83.msParam Δ S) = Δ * ↑m

entries.name: COLT83.supportFn_mtParam
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} {ε : ℝ}, 0 < m → (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < d j) → 0 ≤ ε → ∀ (κ : (j : Fin m) → Fin (d j)), supportFn (COLT83.multitaskSet d) (COLT83.mtParam d ε κ) = 10 * ε

entries.name: COLT83.supportFn_multitaskSet
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ}, (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < d j) → ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))), supportFn (COLT83.multitaskSet d) y = ∑ j, ⨆ l, y.ofLp ⟨j, l⟩

entries.name: COLT83.toEuclideanCLM_inv_apply_toEuclideanCLM
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {S : Matrix ι ι ℝ}, S.PosDef → ∀ (θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM S⁻¹) ((Matrix.toEuclideanCLM S) θ) = θ

entries.name: COLT83.toEuclideanCLM_normalizeMat_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (COLT83.normalizeMat A)) x = (√↑(Fintype.card ι))⁻¹ • (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (CFC.sqrt A⁻¹)) x

entries.name: COLT83.toEuclideanCLM_outerSelf_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (x θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (COLT83.outerSelf x)) θ = inner ℝ x θ • x

entries.name: COLT83.toEuclideanCLM_sum_outerSelf_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {T : ℕ} (x : Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (∑ t, COLT83.outerSelf (x t))) θ = ∑ t, inner ℝ (x t) θ • x t

entries.name: COLT83.toEuclideanLin_designRows_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {T : ℕ} (x : Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (t : Fin T), ((Matrix.toEuclideanLin (COLT83.designRows x)) v).ofLp t = inner ℝ (x t) v

entries.name: COLT83.toEuclideanLin_mtLmat
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ}, Matrix.toEuclideanLin (COLT83.mtLmat d) = COLT83.mtL d

entries.name: COLT83.toEuclideanLin_mtS
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))), (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (COLT83.mtS d)) v = (COLT83.mtL d) ((COLT83.mtL d) v)

entries.name: COLT83.toEuclideanLin_mul_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (A * B)) v = (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A) ((Matrix.toEuclideanLin B) v)

entries.name: COLT83.toEuclideanLin_transpose_spanBasisMatrix_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (k : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ ↥(Submodule.span ℝ 𝒳))), ((Matrix.toEuclideanLin (COLT83.spanBasisMatrix 𝒳).transpose) y).ofLp k = inner ℝ (↑((stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ ↥(Submodule.span ℝ 𝒳)) k)) y

entries.name: COLT83.toEuclideanLin_unifDesignMatrix
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))), (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (COLT83.unifDesignMatrix d)) v = (↑(Fintype.card ((j : Fin m) → Fin (d j))))⁻¹ • ∑ κ, inner ℝ (COLT83.oneHot d κ) v • COLT83.oneHot d κ

entries.name: COLT83.toEuclideanLin_unifDesignMatrix_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))) (i : (j : Fin m) × Fin (d j)), ((Matrix.toEuclideanLin (COLT83.unifDesignMatrix d)) v).ofLp i = (↑(Fintype.card ((j : Fin m) → Fin (d j))))⁻¹ * ∑ κ, inner ℝ (COLT83.oneHot d κ) v * (COLT83.oneHot d κ).ofLp i

entries.name: COLT83.toEuclideanLin_unifDesignMatrix_blockCenter
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ}, (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < d j) → ∀ (l : Fin m) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))), (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (COLT83.unifDesignMatrix d)) (COLT83.blockCenter l v) = (↑(d l))⁻¹ • COLT83.blockCenter l v

entries.name: COLT83.toEuclideanLin_unifDesignMatrix_mtL_mtL
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ}, (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < d j) → 0 < m → ∀ {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))}, v ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (COLT83.multitaskSet d) → (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (COLT83.unifDesignMatrix d)) ((COLT83.mtL d) ((COLT83.mtL d) v)) = v

entries.name: COLT83.toEuclideanLin_unifDesignMatrix_muVec
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ}, (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < d j) → (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (COLT83.unifDesignMatrix d)) (COLT83.muVec d) = COLT83.kappa d • COLT83.muVec d

entries.name: COLT83.toLp_bayesObs
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {T : ℕ} (x : Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (τ : ℝ) (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin T)), WithLp.toLp 2 (COLT83.bayesObs x τ p) = (COLT83.bayesY₁ x τ) p.1 + p.2

entries.name: COLT83.trace_le_of_mem_designSet
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {R : ℝ} [inst : Fintype ι], (∀ x ∈ 𝒳, ‖x‖ ≤ R) → A ∈ COLT83.designSet 𝒳 → A.trace ≤ R ^ 2

entries.name: COLT83.trace_outerSelf
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (COLT83.outerSelf x).trace = ‖x‖ ^ 2

entries.name: COLT83.transpose_designRows_mulVec
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {T : ℕ} (x : Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (y : Fin T → ℝ), (COLT83.designRows x).transpose.mulVec y = (∑ t, y t • x t).ofLp

entries.name: COLT83.transpose_designRows_mul_designRows
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {T : ℕ} (x : Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (COLT83.designRows x).transpose * COLT83.designRows x = ∑ t, COLT83.outerSelf (x t)

entries.name: COLT83.transpose_mtLmat
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ}, (COLT83.mtLmat d).transpose = COLT83.mtLmat d

entries.name: COLT83.transpose_mul_spanBasisMatrix
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)), (COLT83.spanBasisMatrix 𝒳).transpose * COLT83.spanBasisMatrix 𝒳 = 1

entries.name: COLT83.transpose_normalizeMat
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ), (COLT83.normalizeMat A).transpose = COLT83.normalizeMat A

entries.name: COLT83.transpose_spanBasisMatrix_mulVec_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (k : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ ↥(Submodule.span ℝ 𝒳))), (COLT83.spanBasisMatrix 𝒳).transpose.mulVec y.ofLp k = inner ℝ (↑((stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ ↥(Submodule.span ℝ 𝒳)) k)) y

entries.name: COLT83.transpose_sum_outerSelf
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {T : ℕ} (x : Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (∑ t, COLT83.outerSelf (x t)).transpose = ∑ t, COLT83.outerSelf (x t)

entries.name: COLT83.unifDesignMatrix
entries.statement: {m : ℕ} → (d : Fin m → ℕ) → Matrix ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j)) ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j)) ℝ

entries.name: COLT83.unifDesignMatrix_mem_designSet
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ}, (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < d j) → COLT83.unifDesignMatrix d ∈ COLT83.designSet (COLT83.multitaskSet d)

entries.name: COLT83.unitBall

entries.name: COLT83.unitBall_le_budget_of_isPAC
